cases.observation: Centerline reduces the top-block7 collision and changes the yellow-group placement toward reference; several central and lower contacts still overlap. A genuine per-case improvement exists; no claim of dominance.

Both drafts preserve broad reference regions, but centerline has more concentrated intersections around the lower G1/G3 region and the mid-left fixed blocks. Supports inspecting intersection severity rather than red-outline count alone.
Macro regions remain similar. Centerline relocates blocks26/53 and changes upper22/63 relations while many collisions persist elsewhere; there is no consistent overall visual advantage.

Centerline separates the nearly coincident top blocks0/15, a useful local improvement; the MIB49/nearby blocks and lower region remain crowded. This counterexample prevents claiming it fails on every case.
